name: Shimakage Ruri
source:
The protagonist's senpai both at work and school. Straightforward and helpful, a well-behaved girl. Even in unreasonable conversations, she will still listen seriously. When angry, she can become very scary. Her goal is to become a lady, and has the most otome like heart out of the girls. She is self aware of the fact that she can't change her rude nature, and is at her limit at pretending to be a good girl. Close friends with Yukariko.

"Awawa, I have a flower garden inside my head..."
